Pages hold block markup; <!-- wp:pattern {"slug":"..."} /--> is expanded into the pattern's blocks on import. "{{theme}}" stands for the theme folder URL. "screens" lists the URL of each catalogue page. "productCategories", "productTags" and "products" are imported by inc/woo-import.php, only while WooCommerce is active; each product's "Linen weight" attribute is the single source of the weight line shown on cards and product pages. The atelier address, hours, email, delivery, returns and care policy, and the fallback shelf, are not in this file: they live in synced patterns (inc/shared-info.php, inc/info/*.html) that every page references.

site.title: Asa Linen
site.tagline: Flax bedding, washed soft and folded by hand.

posts.title: A morning in the flax field
posts.excerpt: Flax flowers for a single morning. We went to see it before the harvest, and came back with a bunch for the table.
posts.content:
Flax flowers for a single morning. We went to see it before the harvest, and came back with a bunch for the table.

At the atelier

Most of our work is waiting: for the cloth to dry, for the weave to settle after washing, for the light at the window to be good enough to see a flaw in the hem.

It is slow on purpose. Linen that is rushed through a hot wash and a hot dryer comes out harsh; given time and shade, it comes out soft and stays that way.

At home

What you notice is not the process but the feel: cool on the first night, softer by the tenth, and a little more yours with every wash.

Linen keeps the shape of the days you lived in it.

Emi Tokura
